title: FeedbackScoreResponse
description: Response returned after creating or updating a feedback score.

comment.description: Optional comment from the user explaining their score

conversation_id.description: The conversation ID for this feedback score

created.description: When the feedback score was created

id.description: The unique identifier of the feedback score

interaction_id.description: The specific interaction ID within the conversation (optional)

product_source.description: The product source where the feedback was submitted

profile_id.description: The profile ID associated with this feedback (null if not provided)
